name: Gathering Leather
summary: On Thunder Bluff, Veren Tallstrider asks hunters to bring light leather for the capital. He trades crafted goods for the hides, following the tauren way of making clothing and armor from the plains hunt.

sections.title: Sustaining Thunder Bluff
sections.body: Thunder Bluff needs skilled hands to make clothing and armor for its growing population. Veren Tallstrider works skins into useful goods and asks young hunters returning from the plains to bring him their quarry. Their hunts help supply the capital and feed the tribe.

sections.title: The Way of the Hunt
sections.body: Tauren hunt across the grasslands to feed, clothe, and shelter the tribe. Veren Tallstrider asks hunters who would bring honor to their clan for light leather from local wildlife. In return, he trades crafted goods for twelve well-kept hides, sustaining the ties that bind tauren society.

faq.answer: Veren Tallstrider is a leatherworker in Thunder Bluff. He crafts clothing and armor for the tauren, and trades his work for skins from the plains.
Veren needs twelve pieces of light leather from beasts in Mulgore and neighboring territories. He uses the hides to craft goods for Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You meet Veren Tallstrider atop Thunder Bluff. To bring him what he needs, hunt wild beasts in the grasslands below.

faq.q: Why do the tauren place so much importance on hunting beasts?
faq.answer: Tauren hunting honors the balance with the Earth Mother. The tribe uses every part of a fallen beast: its flesh for food, and its bones and cured hides for tools, tents, and armor.

faq.q: Can any Horde adventurer undertake this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Any traveler loyal to the Horde can help gather leather if Veren believes they are eager to test their mettle on the plains.

faq.q: What happens once the leather is delivered?
faq.answer: After you deliver the hides, Veren inspects their quality and commends your work. He gives you a crafted piece of gear in fair trade.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, you honor a fallen beast by turning its hide into useful goods. This discipline has passed through generations.
As a hunter, you are well suited to track prey across Mulgore's plains and gather the light hides Veren needs.
As a member of the Horde, you help supply Thunder Bluff's artisans while the young capital strengthens its defenses and trade networks.
